protocol.benchmark: Same-symbol buy-and-hold price return, identical initial/final dates and per-side costs; dividends excluded.
protocol.capital: Independent $10,000 start per symbol/stage/fold/scenario; fractional long/cash positions, no leverage or interest.
protocol.execution: Previous close versus SMA of preceding closes; next daily bar open; forced liquidation at final close; fixed cost on both sides.
protocol.final_holdout: Evaluate every train-selected window once, even when validation fails; do not tune from final results. Replay is labeled previously observed.
protocol.selection: Highest mean return across three contiguous folds in the latter half of training; ties prefer shorter window. No validation or holdout selection.
protocol.validation_gate: Excess price return > 0, drawdown <= same-symbol benchmark drawdown, and at least two fills at 10 bps per side. Research screening only.
